utility.name: PHP 7.4 unpatched against php2shell (deliberately vulnerable, source build, Debian 10 Buster)
utility.author: Thomas Shaw
utility.description: Builds PHP 7.4 from a source tarball bundled in this module (the php-src tree at commit 004cb827501d1ddaf98daacb185a53e0816f78a7, the commit immediately before the php2shell mitigation) and makes it the default `php`. This is the deliberately vulnerable counterpart of php7_patched: the same 7.4.31-dev tree without the php2shell fix (CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619), for use as a practice target on an isolated lab network. The source is bundled rather than fetched from apt or upstream so the build does not depend on a package manager (which would supply a fixed build) or on the source staying available. Built on Debian 10 Buster (OpenSSL 1.1.1, contemporary toolchain). The build reports 7.4.31-dev, the same version string as the patched build, so whether the fix is present can only be told from the source: the install records the pinned source commit in /opt/php-7.4-vulnerable/PHP2SHELL_VULN_COMMIT and leaves the built source tree on the box for a check to inspect.
